crossRefs.note: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so…
“Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.
For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried…
and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on…
Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the…
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”
The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will…
You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you…
“You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

translations.web: How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals and birds are consumed; because they said, “He won’t see our latter end.”
translations.bsb: How long will the land mourn and the grass of every field be withered? Because of the evil of its residents, the animals and birds have been swept away, for the people have said, “He cannot see what our end will be.”
translations.kjv: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
translations.asv: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? for the wickedness of them that dwell therein, the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our latter end.
